title: Additive attention for one decoder step
goal:
Implement one step of the paper's attention (Section 3.1, Equations 5 and 6, with the alignment model from Appendix A.1.2): $e_{ij} = v_a^\top \tanh(W_a s_{i-1} + U_a h_j)$, $\alpha_{ij} = \operatorname{softmax}_j(e_{ij})$, and $c_i = \sum_j \alpha_{ij} h_j$.

Write `additive_attention(s_prev, H, Wa, Ua, va)`, which returns `(c, alpha)`. `s_prev` has shape `(n,)`. `H` has shape `(Tx, 2n)`, one annotation per row. `Wa` has shape `(n_prime, n)`, `Ua` has shape `(n_prime, 2n)`, and `va` has shape `(n_prime,)`. The context `c` has shape `(2n,)` and the weights `alpha` have shape `(Tx,)`.

The starter includes a finished stable `softmax`.
hints: Compute the pre-activation for all positions at once: `Wa @ s_prev` has shape `(n_prime,)`, and `H @ Ua.T` has shape `(Tx, n_prime)`. NumPy broadcasts the sum.
Keep the `tanh`. Without it the score splits into a term for `s_prev` and a term for `h_j`, and the first term cancels in the softmax.
The score for position $j$ is the dot product of `va` with row $j$ of the tanh output.
The context is `alpha @ H`, a weighted sum of the rows of `H`.
